note: A four-view of the ZSU-37 with no scale on the sheet. Its six road wheels agree with the SU-76M drawing's at 73.6 px/m along the side and the plan; the front and the rear agree with the same track centres at 78.8 and 75.2 across, and are read at 74.5 up. The chassis is the SU-76M's, which this sheet draws about 0.9 units higher on the same wheels, so the side, front and rear are pinned at the deck rather than the ground.
